e: Tocilizumab: monoclonal antibody blocking the IL-6 receptor (IL-6R) → RA, cytokine release syndrome
Methotrexate inhibits DHFR → ↓ THF → ↓ purine & thymidylate synthesis (S-phase specific); leucovorin rescue
Rifampicin = CYP450 inducer → ↑ OCP metabolism → contraceptive failure
Clarithromycin inhibits P-gp & gut flora that inactivate digoxin → ↑ digoxin levels (toxicity)
Metronidazole + alcohol → disulfiram-like reaction (flushing, vomiting, palpitations)
Topiramate: antiepileptic c̅ a role in migraine prophylaxis; side effects: weight loss, kidney stones, paresthesia

Liraglutide (GLP-1 agonist) is approved for long-term obesity management.
Sibutramine & fenfluramine were withdrawn

Oral candidiasis (thrush) after inhaled steroids → topical azole (clotrimazole).
Griseofulvin & terbinafine are for dermatophytes

Carboprost (PGF2α) causes bronchospasm → avoid in asthma.
Methylergometrine: avoid in hypertension

Omapatrilat: vasopeptidase inhibitor → blocks ACE + neprilysin; angioedema limited its use.
Sacubitril: neprilysin only
Amiodarone: pulmonary fibrosis, hypothyroidism (fatigue, weight gain), corneal deposits, bluish skin
Salicylate poisoning: sodium bicarbonate alkalinizes urine → ↑ salicylate excretion (ion trapping)
Abrupt clonidine withdrawal → sympathetic surge → rebound hypertension (headache)

Allopurinol inhibits xanthine oxidase → ↓ uric acid synthesis.
Probenecid = uricosuric; colchicine = acute attack

Oprelvekin (IL-11) ↑es platelet production.
Filgrastim → neutrophils; EPO → RBCs
Losartan also blocks thromboxane A2 receptors → ↓ platelet aggregation (plus uricosuric action)
4 → 1 needs 2 half-lives (4 → 2 → 1) = 2 × 40 = 80 hours
Atropine toxicity → anticholinergic hyperthermia (hot, dry, flushed skin, mydriasis)
tPA converts plasminogen → plasmin → fibrin degradation (fibrinolysis)

Benralizumab: anti-IL-5Rα antibody → eosinophil depletion (severe eosinophilic asthma).
Mepolizumab/reslizumab bind IL-5 itself

Propranolol is a first-line migraine prophylactic.
Triptans/ergots are vasoconstrictors → avoided in CAD
Pegloticase = recombinant uricase → oxidizes uric acid to soluble allantoin
Metoclopramide (D2 antagonist, 5-HT4 agonist) ↑es LES tone & gastric emptying

Loop diuretics (furosemide) waste Ca²⁺ → urinary Ca²⁺ ↑es → stones.
Thiazides: opposite (urinary Ca²⁺ ↓es)
Start ATT first, add ART after ~2 weeks once ATT is tolerated → balances IRIS risk c̅ mortality
BPaLM (Bedaquiline, Pretomanid, Linezolid, Moxifloxacin) = 6-month regimen for MDR/RR-TB; monitor for IRIS in HIV

Tardive dyskinesia (chronic antipsychotic use) → VMAT2 inhibitors (valbenazine, deutetrabenazine).
Acute dystonia → anticholinergics; akathisia → propranolol

Verapamil (oral) used for PSVT prophylaxis (AV nodal block).
IV adenosine = acute termination
Persistent nocturnal symptoms on SABA ± SAMA → step up to ICS + LABA (controller therapy)
Amiodarone (class III) blocks K⁺ channels → prolongs phase 3 repolarization
